request.style: English, warm female solo voice with gentle choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft percussion, gentle and reflective mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Brothers of the carpenter's son
James, Joseph, Simon, Judas
Sisters nearby, asking why
Where did he get all this?

[Verse]
Then he appeared to James
Then to all the apostles
Faith came in the risen light
Believing in the new life

[Chorus]
James, Cephas, and John
Reputed to be pillars
Giving the right hand of fellowship
To Paul and to Barnabas

[Verse]
Brothers, listen to me
Simeon has described
How God took a people
For his holy name

[Pre-Chorus]
Rebuilding the fallen tent
Of David, setting it up
So the rest of humanity
May seek the Lord

[Chorus]
James, Cephas, and John
Reputed to be pillars
Giving the right hand of fellowship
To Paul and to Barnabas

[Bridge]
Twelve tribes scattered abroad
Servant of God and Christ
Greetings to the diaspora
Faith and works in your hearts

[Outro]
From ancient generations Moses
Read in the synagogues
James stands as a pillar
Righteous and true
